title: Disney Hits & Sing-Alongs Music Bingo
shortDescription: Disney Hits & Sing-Alongs Music Bingo at WesCo Brew & Bowl on November 10.
description: Bring your people to WesCo Brew & Bowl for Disney Hits & Sing-Alongs Music Bingo with Four Dogs Entertainment. Listen for familiar songs from Disney movies and shows, mark them on your bingo card, and sing along with friends as you play.
instructions: Join us at WesCo for free Music Bingo at 7:00 PM. Food and drinks are purchased separately. Contact the venue for seating details.
